business: MagnetEngine (AI-written, human-approved cold Instagram DM outreach)
target: People who sell a $1,000+/month retainer or a $2,000+ project through cold Instagram DMs: SMMA and marketing agency owners, online coaches, and B2B service freelancers (SEO, ads, web design), at $0 to $50k a month in revenue
where: Online, mostly US, UK, Canada and Australia, plus offshore agency owners selling to those markets

segments.name: Early-stage agency owner or freelancer (under $5k/month revenue)
Growing SMMA or agency owner ($10k-$50k/month revenue)
Online coach or course creator selling a high-ticket program
Appointment setter or SDR who runs outreach for a client

behaviours.name: Sends DMs by hand every day
behaviours.how: Spends one to three hours a day finding profiles and typing openers; it works a bit, but it is exhausting and stops whenever client work gets busy.

behaviours.name: Burned by a DM bot before
behaviours.how: Paid for a cheap mass-DM tool, got almost no replies and an action block, and now distrusts anything that says automation.

behaviours.name: Tool tinkerer
behaviours.how: Tries every new growth tool on a free trial, cancels most of them, and compares prices before committing.

behaviours.name: Protective of their Instagram account
behaviours.how: Their main account is their storefront and their proof; losing it would cost months of content and clients.

behaviours.name: Already pays a setter or VA
behaviours.how: Pays a person (often offshore, base plus commission) to prospect and work the inbox, and is unsure whether software could replace them.

behaviours.name: Content-first, mostly inbound
behaviours.how: Gets leads from posting and comment-to-DM; does a little cold outreach when the pipeline is thin.

behaviours.name: Follows a guru's outreach playbook
behaviours.how: Learned cold DMs from a course or a YouTube SMMA guru and does what the playbook says, including which tools to use.

objections: $147 a month is three or four times what other Instagram DM tools charge
Will this get my Instagram account restricted or banned?
There are no reviews or case studies, so how do I know it books calls?
AI-written DMs always sound robotic; prospects can tell
A 3-day trial that bills on day 4, with payments final, feels like a trap
I would have to keep an Instagram tab open for hours every day
I cannot justify another subscription until I land the next client
My cold DMs are not the problem; my offer or my content is
habits: you check your Instagram DMs first thing every morning
you are juggling two or three clients and your pipeline dries up every other month
you watch SMMA and outreach videos on YouTube at night
you track your leads in a Google Sheet
you work from a laptop with twenty Chrome tabs open
you have a discovery-call link in your bio that rarely gets clicked
